copy.npr_heading: ASKO Style 86cm XXL 16 Place Fully Integrated Dishwasher – Grey
copy.npr_short_copy: A full sink after dinner can mean running multiple loads. This ASKO dishwasher holds 16 place settings, uses Auto Dosing and offers 16 wash programs, while floor projection shows cycle status and automatic door opening helps release steam.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Large cookware and a full family load can be difficult to fit into one dishwasher cycle. This ASKO Style 86cm XXL dishwasher holds 16 place settings, giving busy households room for dishes, cookware and cutlery in one load. Its fully integrated design sits behind your cabinetry for a consistent kitchen look.

When dishes have different levels of soil, the Sensi Clean™ Sensor detects the dirtiness level to help select the wash approach. Super Cleaning System™ tackles tougher messes in one step, while 16 wash programs give you options for different loads. Auto Dosing adds detergent automatically, so you won't need to measure it for every cycle.

Touch controls and an LED display keep settings easy to see, while floor projection uses three colours to show cycle progress and status without opening the door. Delay Start lets you set washing around your routine, and Wi-Fi connectivity allows remote control and monitoring through a smartphone or tablet. Turbo Combi Drying and the Door Pop-Out function help manage moisture after washing, while the child lock and Water Safety System add protection during everyday use.

The cutlery basket gives loose utensils a dedicated place, and the extra-deep knife holder helps keep blades steady during washing. This dishwasher uses 10.6L per wash and has a 6-star WELS water rating, plus a 5-star energy rating. It measures 596mm wide, 859mm high and 554mm deep, and comes with a two-year warranty. After a family dinner, you can load the cookware, set the cycle and see its status from across the kitchen.

copy.npr_heading: ASKO Essence Combined Microwave Oven – Black Glass
copy.npr_short_copy: When weekday meals need more than one cooking method, this ASKO Essence oven combines microwave, fan-forced oven and grill functions in a 50L cavity. Auto programmes, Air Fry functionality and ConnectLife controls help you choose settings for baking, roasting or grilling.
copy.npr_long_copy:
When one appliance needs to handle reheating, baking and grilling, switching between separate cooking methods can make meal preparation feel disjointed. This ASKO Essence combined microwave oven brings microwave, fan-forced oven and grill functions together in a 50L cavity, giving home cooks one place to prepare weekday meals and weekend dishes.

Precise temperature control and CelsiusºCooking technology help you set the heat for baking, roasting or grilling. The oven’s calibrating system supports consistent cooking, while Auto Programmes help you select an appropriate setting when you don’t want to start from scratch. Air Fry functionality gives you another way to prepare meals, and the multi-functional tray supports different cooking tasks.

The 3″ TFT display gives you a clear way to access functions and settings, while ConnectLife lets you connect this oven with the associated app for added control. Telescopic runners help you slide cookware out for easier access, and illumination on both sides at different heights helps you see food as it cooks. Active cooling helps manage the oven and door glass during use.

When cooking leaves residue behind, pyrolytic cleaning heats the cavity so the remaining food can be wiped away as ash. This oven includes a grill rack, glass baking tray and middle baking pan, giving you the basic equipment for different recipes. Its black glass finish suits contemporary kitchens, while the 594mm width and 455mm height suit a compact built-in installation, with dinner, baking and grilling handled in one appliance.

copy.npr_heading: AEG 10kg Front Load Washing Machine – White
copy.npr_short_copy: Laundry can pile up quickly in a busy household, especially when different fabrics need different care. This 10kg front load washing machine uses AutoDose, PreciseWash and steam options to adjust washing for each load, while its 5-star energy and 4.5-star WELS ratings support more considered everyday washing.
copy.npr_long_copy:
A full laundry basket can be difficult to manage when cottons, woollens and delicate fabrics all need different settings. This 10kg front load washing machine gives growing households and busy professionals room for larger mixed loads, with dedicated programmes to help match washing to the fabrics being cleaned.

AutoDose releases detergent and fabric conditioner automatically, so you won't need to measure each wash. PowerCare premixes detergent before it enters the drum, helping detergent spread through the load. PreciseWash adjusts energy use and settings to the weight of each load, so smaller washes don't need to be treated like a full drum. Steam options add a de-wrinkling choice for suitable cotton and synthetic items.

The Hygiene programme provides a dedicated option for white cotton items, while Delicate and Wool programmes give suitable garments their own settings. Electronic rotary and touchscreen controls, an LCD display and cycle indicators make it easier to check progress, load capacity and the selected spin speed. The stainless-steel drum, variable spin speed and maximum 1600rpm spin setting support different laundry routines.

With a 5-star energy rating and 4.5-star WELS rating, this washer helps households keep energy and water use in mind during regular washing. Its 86L water consumption per wash and 52dBA noise level are included for planning where it will sit. Finished in White, this machine comes with a 5-year warranty and suits a family laundry handling everything from everyday cottons to woollens on a busy weekend.

copy.npr_heading: LG CordZero Stick Vacuum with All-in-One Tower – Grey
copy.npr_short_copy: When dust and hair build up during cleaning, this LG CordZero stick vacuum compresses collected dirt to help you empty less often. Its All-in-One Tower auto-empties, charges and stores accessories, while dual nozzles, a Power Drive mop and washable filters help tackle carpets and hard floors.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Dust and hair can build up before you’ve finished cleaning, leaving you with another bin to empty. This LG CordZero stick vacuum uses Kompressor Technology to compress collected dirt, while its All-in-One Tower auto-empties the vacuum, charges it and keeps accessories together after each clean.

Up to 220W suction power helps this vacuum pick up everyday mess from carpets and hard floors. The dual nozzle system lets you switch between floor-cleaning tasks, while the Power Drive mop adds wet cleaning when your routine needs more than vacuuming. Smart Inverter technology supports reliable operation as you move from room to room.

One Touch Control keeps operation straightforward when you’re cleaning around furniture or reaching into corners. The washable dustbin and filters can be rinsed as part of regular maintenance, so you don’t need to replace them after every clean. The tower’s auto-empty function also helps keep dust contained while you put the vacuum away.

With a grey finish, a 60-minute runtime and a 2.5L tower dust capacity, this vacuum suits homes that need regular cleaning across carpets and hard floors. Its ergonomic handle makes it easier to guide during everyday use, while the two-year warranty adds support after purchase. When the floors need attention after dinner, you can vacuum, mop and return everything to one place.

knownIssues: RESOLVED by MM (29 Oct 2026): the 2,500ml figure is the tower BAG capacity, not the vacuum's dustbin. Write it as 2.5L (vendor convention).

copy.npr_heading: Sunbeam Lower Back Heating Pad – Grey
copy.npr_short_copy: Long hours at a desk or relaxing on the sofa can leave you wanting focused warmth. This heating pad wraps around your waist with an adjustable strap, five heat settings and a digital controller, while its soft machine-washable fabric makes it easy to use at home.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Cold evenings or long hours at a desk can leave you reaching for a heat pack that won't stay in place. This Sunbeam Lower Back Heating Pad wraps around your waist with an adjustable strap that fits waists up to 54 inches, helping keep focused warmth where you need it while you work on your laptop or relax on the sofa.

The pad flexes to improve body contact, so it can sit closely around your lower back as you move. Its five heat settings let you choose the warmth that fits the moment, while the fast heat-up setting gets warmth to the pad in 90 seconds <sup>1</sup>. Intellisense Technology helps prevent overheating and maintains a consistent temperature during use.

A digital controller puts the heat settings within reach, so you won't need to adjust the pad itself. The detachable controller makes cleaning simpler, and the 2.2m cord gives you room to settle in near a power point. Automatic shut-off cuts power after three hours of continuous use, adding a useful stop when you're relaxing at home.

Soft polyester fabric feels comfortable against clothing and can go in the washing machine when the pad needs freshening up. This 110W grey heating pad weighs 0.95kg and measures 370mm wide by 370mm high, with a 15mm depth. It's backed by a two-year warranty, making it a handy choice for chilly evenings, desk work or quiet time on the couch.
copy.disclaimers: (1) Setting 5 is for rapid heat up only and isn't suitable for continuous or prolonged use.

knownIssues: UNRESOLVED, waiting on MM: Nexus says 110 W, the old Perplexity Project output said 75 W. Neither is confirmed.

copy.npr_heading: Zip HydroTap G5 BCS Home Classic Plus Tap – Chrome
copy.npr_short_copy: Needing boiling, chilled or sparkling water can mean juggling appliances and bottles. This Zip HydroTap provides filtered water in three styles from one tap, with a boiling water safety lock, simple controls and energy-saving modes for everyday kitchen use.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Making tea, filling a bottle and preparing sparkling drinks can leave your kitchen crowded with separate appliances. This Zip HydroTap brings boiling, chilled, sparkling and filtered water to one Chrome tap, giving households a single point for everyday drinks and food preparation.

Simple controls let you choose your water type, while continuous flow helps fill bottles without repeatedly pressing the control. A boiling water safety lock adds an extra step before dispensing hot water, and two boiling safety modes let you set the system around how your household uses it. Leak-guard detection helps identify water leaks, while advanced filtration supports great-tasting water.

The under-bench command centre has a full-colour interactive touch screen, pin code protection and customisable settings. Three energy-saving modes include on/off timers and a sensor-activated sleep mode that responds when it's dark, helping the system avoid running at times you don't need it. Quiet mode adjusts fan speed automatically, and SteriTouch antimicrobial protection is built into the touch-pad and key water paths.

This tap uses a 35mm bench cut-out and a 1/2-inch BSP water connection. Its 339mm width, 483mm depth and 333mm height need to fit beneath your bench, with the system connected by a qualified person <sup>1</sup>. The Chrome finish suits contemporary kitchens, and a five-year warranty includes 36 months for the appliance plus an additional 24 months for the tank. Picture filling a bottle, making tea and pouring sparkling water for guests without moving from the kitchen sink.
copy.disclaimers: (1) Installation and connection of your Zip HydroTap must be carried out by a qualified person, observing national and local regulations.

copy.npr_heading: Schweigen Silent Undermount Rangehood 1200mm – Black Steel
copy.npr_short_copy: Cooking several dishes can leave steam, smoke and odours hanging around the kitchen. This ducted rangehood uses an Isodrive motor, five speed levels and LED lighting to clear the air, while soft-touch controls and dishwasher-safe mesh filters make everyday use and cleaning simpler.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Steam, smoke and cooking odours can build up when several burners are working at once. This ducted undermount rangehood fits discreetly into cabinetry and gives larger kitchens a broad 1180mm extraction area, helping keep the cooking zone clearer while its Black Steel finish suits modern joinery.

The Isodrive SE motor delivers up to 3200m³/hr airflow, giving you strong extraction for busy cooking sessions when correctly ducted and installed <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>. Five speed levels let you match the airflow to simmering, everyday meals or heavier cooking, so you can adjust it as the meal changes. The 15-minute auto shut-off timer keeps extraction running after cooking without needing another trip to the controls.

Soft-touch controls and a digital display make selecting a setting straightforward, while two 3W LED lights brighten the cooktop as you prepare food. Four stainless steel black mesh filters catch grease during cooking and can go in the dishwasher when they need cleaning. This rangehood is ducted only and doesn't include a recirculation option.

Schweigen SteelFlex™ ducting is included, and this rangehood comes with a 10-year motor warranty, five-year canopy warranty, lifetime filter warranty and lifetime GU10 LED globe warranty. At 1180mm wide, 295mm deep and 285mm high, it suits a generous cooktop concealed beneath overhead cabinetry, keeping the kitchen ready for the next family dinner or shared meal.
copy.disclaimers:
(1) When a model with the larger motored Isodrive® System is operated at the higher speed/s air movement may be heard. For example, while operating on speed 4 & 5 (For 5 speed models) the rangehood may be audible due to the large amount of air movement moving through the filter.
(2) Please make sure that the rangehood and motor have been installed as per the corresponding instruction guides in order for optimal performance (the Isodrive® Motor Manual can be found with the Isodrive® Motor, or online at schweigen.com.au).

copy.npr_heading: Schweigen Silent Inline Motor Undermount Rangehood 120cm – Black Steel
copy.npr_short_copy: Cooking several dishes at once can leave your kitchen full of steam and odours. This 120cm ducted rangehood uses five fan speeds, LED lighting and a 15-minute auto shut-off timer to help manage busy meals, while dishwasher-safe black mesh filters make cleaning simpler.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Large cooktops can make overhead space feel crowded, especially when you want extraction without a visible canopy. This 120cm ducted undermount rangehood fits discreetly into 300mm-deep cabinetry, helping keep your kitchen’s clean, contemporary look while managing steam and cooking odours during everyday meals.

Five speed levels let you match airflow to what’s happening on the cooktop, from lighter cooking to a busy multi-burner meal. The Isodrive SPINL motor supports powerful extraction, while the inline motor system keeps this rangehood suitable for kitchens where a concealed installation matters <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>. A 15-minute auto shut-off timer can keep it running after cooking, helping clear remaining vapours while you start serving.

Soft-touch controls and a digital display make it simple to select a setting, and the LED lighting helps illuminate the cooking area when you’re preparing dinner. The black mesh filters are dishwasher-safe, so you can remove them for cleaning rather than scrubbing them in place. This rangehood is ducted and doesn’t offer recirculation, so installation needs to suit the kitchen’s ducting setup.

The Black Steel finish adds a dark, understated look to contemporary cabinetry and large island benches. This rangehood includes Schweigen SteelFlex™ and comes with a 10-year motor warranty, five-year canopy warranty, lifetime filter warranty and lifetime GU10 LED globe warranty. It’s a strong fit for home cooks who want concealed extraction across a wide cooktop, from weekday stir-fries to dinner with guests.

copy.npr_heading: Haier 60cm 500 Series Freestanding Cooker, Ceramic – Stainless Steel
copy.npr_short_copy: Cooking several dishes can leave your cooktop and oven working overtime. This Haier freestanding cooker combines four ceramic cook zones with an 88L oven and 11 functions, including Air Fry and steam-assisted cooking, so you can prepare family meals and weekend feasts in one appliance.
copy.npr_long_copy:
A busy kitchen can quickly run out of room when you’re preparing a family meal. This Haier freestanding cooker brings four ceramic cook zones and an 88L oven together, giving you one stainless steel appliance for stovetop cooking, baking, grilling and roasting.

The 11 oven functions include Air Fry and steam-assisted cooking, so you can prepare a broader range of meals in the same oven. Air Fry helps you make fried-style favourites, while steam-assisted cooking supports bread, pastries and cakes. The four cook zones let you use multiple pots and pans when several parts of dinner need attention.

Dial controls make it straightforward to select a cooking function and temperature, while the oven clock and timer help you keep track of dishes as you move between preparation tasks. A rear internal light lets you check food inside the oven, and the cooling fan helps manage heat around this appliance during use. The storage drawer gives you a place to keep cookware close at hand.

When cooking is finished, Hydro Clean uses steam to help lift light residue from the oven interior before you wipe it clean. The removable oven door also makes access easier during cleaning. This cooker includes an air fry tray, baking tray, grill insert and wire shelf, plus a splashback. At 595mm wide and 600mm deep, it suits kitchens with a compact freestanding layout, and the 2-year warranty supports everyday family cooking from weeknight dinners to weekend entertaining.
